verdict.rationale: Bento's MCP server lets an AI assistant create broadcasts and target subscribers, and segment filtering exists (bento-docs-5, bento-docs-8, bento-docs-26), suggesting an agent could draft a campaign against a segment. However, there is no documentation describing a scheduled/queued draft state that requires explicit human approval before send — the evidence never mentions an approval gate or hold-for-review workflow. missing for 10: explicit human-approval/queue-before-send mechanism, confirmation that AI-created broadcasts default to draft rather than auto-send, independent verification of this workflow.
